description.zh: 用于对Object名称进行分组的字符。所有名称包含指定的前缀且首次出现delimiter字符之间的Object作为一组元素CommonPrefixes。
description.en: The character used to group object names. All objects whose names contain the specified prefix and between which the delimiter character appears for the first time are grouped as a CommonPrefixes element.

description.zh:
指定对返回的内容进行编码，指定编码的类型。Delimiter、KeyMarker、Prefix、NextKeyMarker和Key使用UTF-8字符，但xml 1.0标准不支持解析一些控制字符，例如ASCII值从0到10的字符。对于包含xml
                              1.0标准不支持的控制字符，可以通过指定encoding-type对返回的Delimiter、KeyMarker、Prefix、NextKeyMarker和Key进行编码。

默认值：无
description.en:
Specifies the encoding type for the returned content. Delimiter, KeyMarker, Prefix, NextKeyMarker, and Key use UTF-8 characters, but XML 1.0 does not support parsing certain control characters, such as characters with ASCII values from 0 to 10. For control characters that are not supported by the XML 1.0 standard, you can specify encoding-type to encode the returned Delimiter, KeyMarker, Prefix, NextKeyMarker, and Key.

Default value: none.

description.zh:
与upload-id-marker参数配合使用，用于指定返回结果的起始位置。
  - 如果未设置upload-id-marker参数，查询结果中包含所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
  - 如果设置了upload-id-marker参数，查询结果中包含：
    - 所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
    - Object名称等于key-marker参数值，但是UploadId比upload-id-marker参数值大的Multipart Upload事件。
description.en:
Used together with the upload-id-marker parameter to specify the starting position of the returned results.
  - If the upload-id-marker parameter is not set, the query results include all multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
  - If the upload-id-marker parameter is set, the query results include:
    - All multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
    - Multipart upload events whose object names are equal to the key-marker parameter value but whose UploadId is greater than the upload-id-marker parameter value.

description.zh: 限定此次返回Multipart Upload事件的最大个数，默认值为1000。最大值为1000。
description.en: The maximum number of multipart upload events to return. Default value: 1000. Maximum value: 1000.

description.zh:
限定返回的Object Key必须以prefix作为前缀。注意使用prefix查询时，返回的Key中仍会包含prefix。
> 您可以灵活地使用prefix参数对Bucket内的Object进行分组管理（类似文件夹功能）。
description.en:
Specifies that the returned object keys must be prefixed with this value. Note that when you use the prefix parameter for a query, the returned keys still contain the prefix.
> Use the prefix parameter to group and manage objects in a bucket (similar to a folder feature).

description.zh:
与key-marker参数配合使用，用于指定返回结果的起始位置。
  - 如果未设置key-marker参数，则OSS会忽略upload-id-marker参数。
  - 如果设置了key-marker参数，查询结果中包含：
    - 所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
    - Object名称等于key-marker参数值，但是UploadId比upload-id-marker参数值大的Multipart Upload事件。
description.en:
Used together with the key-marker parameter to specify the starting position of the returned results.
  - If the key-marker parameter is not set, OSS ignores the upload-id-marker parameter.
  - If the key-marker parameter is set, the query results include:
    - All multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
    - Multipart upload events whose object names are equal to the key-marker parameter value but whose UploadId is greater than the upload-id-marker parameter value.

title.zh: 列举执行中的分片上传事件

descriptions.zh: 调用ListMultipartUploads接口列举所有执行中的Multipart Upload事件，即已经初始化但还未完成（Complete）或者还未中止（Abort）的Multipart Upload事件。
descriptions.en: Calls the ListMultipartUploads operation to list all in-progress multipart upload events, which are events that have been initiated but have not been completed (Complete) or aborted (Abort).
